Configure options

MOZ_AUTOMATION=1 --enable-project=mobile/android --target=arm-linux-androideabi MOZILLA_OFFICIAL=1 --enable-update-channel=release MOZBUILD_STATE_PATH=/builds/worker/.mozbuild --disable-compile-environment MOZ_FETCHES_DIR=/builds/worker/fetches --enable-geckoview-lite MOZ_SOURCE_REPO=https://hg.mozilla.org/releases/mozilla-release MOZ_SOURCE_CHANGESET=e4ce606692cd81e6898547e2edd7c552fefcbb04 --enable-js-shell --enable-rust-simd --with-mozilla-api-keyfile=/builds/mozilla-fennec-geoloc-api.key --with-google-safebrowsing-api-keyfile=/builds/sb-gapi.data MOZ_REQUIRE_SIGNING= --enable-official-branding MOZ_SIMPLE_PACKAGE_NAME=target MOZ_PACKAGE_JSSHELL=1 --with-gradle=/builds/worker/fetches/android-gradle-dependencies/gradle-dist/bin/gradle GRADLE_MAVEN_REPOSITORIES=file:///builds/worker/fetches/android-gradle-dependencies/mozilla,file:///builds/worker/fetches/android-gradle-dependencies/google,file:///builds/worker/fetches/android-gradle-dependencies/central,file:///builds/worker/fetches/android-gradle-dependencies/gradle-plugins MOZ_ANDROID_FAT_AAR_ARCHITECTURES=armeabi-v7a,arm64-v8a,x86_64 JS_BINARY=/builds/worker/checkouts/gecko/mobile/android/config/js_wrapper.sh
